description:
Register for an Ohmyfin API key to use paid tools.

Creates an account and sends a 6-digit verification code to your
email. After receiving the code, call mcp_verify to complete
registration and get your API key.

By setting accept_terms to true, you confirm acceptance of the
Ohmyfin Terms & Conditions (https://ohmyfin.ai/terms) on behalf
of your operator, including the API/MCP access terms (Section 3A),
sanctions screening terms (Section 3B), and financial data
disclaimer (Section 3C).

Examples:
  mcp_register("agent@example.com", "Acme Corp", true)

accept_terms.description: Must be true. Confirms acceptance of the Ohmyfin Terms & Conditions at https://ohmyfin.ai/terms.

email.description: Your email address. The verification code is sent to it.

name: mcp_register
title: Register for an API Key
